notes.title: 🔥 Ritual Party - Patch Update! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've received your feedback and have just released a new update with several important fixes to improve your Ritual Party experience. Check out the patch notes below!

🛠 Patch Notes:
✅ Fixed bugs related to fetching items for the Grocery Neighbour – tasks should now work as intended.
✅ Fixed candle mechanics – they should now function correctly in rituals.
✅ Fixed controller issues in the main menu – navigating menus with a gamepad should be work as intended.

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback! If you run into any more issues or have suggestions, let us know in the community forums or on our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/aHftP9jMHZ]Discord Link[/url]

Cheers 🔮👻
